evidence.quote: The Baume & Mercier Classima serves as an entry point to a brand that has a rich horological history

the brand also offers a line of more affordable options powered by the Sellita SW200. The Clifton Baumatic line - powered by an in-house caliber - is a current highlight from the brand's collection, but the Classima offers a classically-styled Baume & Mercier dress watch at half the price.
